$comment: Extraction vectors for the JSONPath subset in spec/04-expression-language.md#extraction--a-jsonpath-subset. Every runtime's extraction implementation must match every case here exactly, including the missing-path cases: `missing: true` means the runtime's result for this path must be the explicit missing-value the runtime uses internally to mean 'did not resolve': never null coerced to a value, never an empty string, never a thrown error for extraction itself (a step that requires the value to resolve fails at the point it's used, not at extraction).
